sql_query: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(profit),0)/1000.0,2) AS total_profit_k FROM Orders;
description: Total profit in thousands. Sum of Orders.profit divided by 1,000 and rounded to 2 decimals.

sql_query: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(profit),0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(sales),0),0),2) AS profit_margin_pct FROM Orders;
description: Profit margin as a percentage (SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) * 100), rounded to 2 decimals. Uses NULLIF to avoid division by zero.

sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders FROM Orders;
description: Count of distinct orders (COUNT DISTINCT Orders.order_id).

sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_customers FROM Orders;
description: Count of distinct customers (COUNT DISTINCT Orders.customer_id).

sql_query: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM Returns),0) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM Orders),0),2) AS return_rate_pct;
description: Return rate as percentage = COUNT DISTINCT(Returns.order_id) / COUNT DISTINCT(Orders.order_id) * 100, rounded to 2 decimals. Uses subqueries and NULLIF to handle zero orders.
